name: Integrative Life Sciences PhD
summary: Interdisciplinary research PhD in integrative life sciences, separate from the Biomedical Sciences Doctoral Portal.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Catalog gives January 10 annually. Catalog GRE statements conflict; confirm directly before applying. School page mixes MD/PhD and MS Biology instructions, which are not applied to this standalone PhD.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall competitive application
publishedDeadlines.note: All components must arrive by this undated deadline to be competitive.

documents: Official transcripts from all postsecondary institutions
External evaluation of non-US undergraduate transcripts

applicationFee.note: Nonrefundable per graduate application. No ILS waiver policy established; BSDP waiver restriction not borrowed.

english.toefl: 100 as stated by ILS; central new-scale minimum4.5, confirm ILS new-scale threshold
english.note: ILS specifies minimum IELTS band scores of 7.0; confirm each band. ILS higher than central80/IELTS6.5. Central tests valid two years; PTE65/DET110 accepted generally, confirm ILS acceptance of alternatives. Central exemption: bachelor/higher from listed English-speaking-country institutions, or completed VCU English Language Program. English-medium degree elsewhere not automatically covered.

requirements.note: Preparatory accredited degree/equivalent and GPA3. Advisers/mentors should assess life-sciences research ability. Strongly contact potential advisers; identified adviser gives admission/funding preference. Catalog explicitly says GRE not required but the same materials paragraph demands official GRE scores; conservative required flag pending clarification. No lab-admission model inferred from preference alone.

funding.note: School says it seeks to support qualified students subject to available funds; adviser identification gives funding preference. No universal package, amount or international guarantee established.
